{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "ring_halogen_lipophilic_scaffold",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "dense_ring_scaffold_promoted",
          "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_high"},
          "weight": 0.6,
          "rationale": "Fused ring density adds rigid hydrophobic surface; source ring role also carried the strongest transfer weight."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "halogen_free_penalized",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_none"},
          "weight": -0.5,
          "rationale": "Halogens raise logD via polarizable, weakly solvated surface; their absence removes a major lipophilicity contributor."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "halogen_substituted_aromatic",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_mid", "aromatic_bin": "aromatic_high"},
          "weight": 0.5,
          "rationale": "Halogenated aromatic rings are the classic high-logD motif, combining ring hydrophobicity with halogen surface effects."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "heavy_branching_penalized",
          "conditions": {"branch_bin": "branch_high"},
          "weight": -0.35,
          "rationale": "Heavy branching in this library usually marks polar side chains and flexible solvated groups that depress logD."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.5,
      "prior_scale": 0.28,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.32,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.12,
      "ucb_weight": 0.55,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.5,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.2,
      "gp_xi": 0.02,
      "confidence": 0.62,
      "hypothesis": "Rigid halogenated aromatic scaffolds maximize lipophilicity while branching signals polar substitution. Fails if halogen bins mostly mark polar heteroaryl chlorides or if ring-dense candidates are also hetero-saturated."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "size_inversion_counter_hypothesis",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "long_string_reversed_positive",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_long"},
          "weight": 0.35,
          "rationale": "Counter to the assumed sign flip: larger molecules often add hydrophobic carbon surface rather than polar burden."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "short_fragment_penalized",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_short"},
          "weight": -0.5,
          "rationale": "Small fragments lack accumulated hydrophobic surface; source evidence favored short strings for solubility, opposing lipophilicity."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "hetero_rich_penalized",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": -0.45,
          "rationale": "Dense heteroatoms add hydrogen bonding and desolvation cost, the standard mechanism lowering measured logD."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "hydrocarbon_rich_aromatic",
          "conditions": {"aromatic_bin": "aromatic_high", "hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_low"},
          "weight": 0.6,
          "rationale": "Aromatic carbon frameworks with few heteroatoms are the most hydrophobic combination available in this catalog."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.32,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.28,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.1,
      "ucb_weight": 0.5,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.2,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.03,
      "confidence": 0.45,
      "hypothesis": "Reverses the length penalty: molecular size may raise lipophilicity while heteroatom density, not string length, drives losses. Fails if long candidates are peptide-like or heavily heteroatom-substituted."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "ring_halogen_lipophilic_scaffold",
  "lesson": "Development seeds favored the ring/halogen scaffold skill over the length-penalty transfer, suggesting scaffold hydrophobicity descriptors carry more usable signal than inverted source size priors, though eight seeds cannot confirm mechanism.",
  "revision_summary": "Refined the better-performing ring/halogen skill by replacing the weak ring_mid rule with a halogenated-aromatic interaction and softening the branching penalty; added size_inversion_counter_hypothesis that reverses the smiles_length prior and shifts blame to heteroatom density. Deployed the scaffold skill."
}
